result: If I could change the world in one way, I would promote global access to quality education. Education empowers individuals, fosters critical thinking, and combats inequality. By ensuring that everyone, regardless of background or location, has access to quality education, we could alleviate poverty, encourage innovation, and create a more equitable and informed society. This change could have a ripple effect, leading to improvements in health, economic stability, and social cohesion around the globe.
